item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 06/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure over the northern part of southern China will move southwards and edge closer towards the coast of Guangdong today, the weather over the region will become unsettled gradually. The trough of low pressure is expected to linger over the coastal areas in the middle and latter parts of this week, bringing heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the region.

Date/Month: 06/06 (Monday)
Wind: Southwest force 4 to 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be more frequent later.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
